methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Loombotic operates in Robotics & Manufacturing at an undisclosed stage. The valuation universe comprises one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. This represents a sector with limited public benchmarks and a moderately sized private peer cohort.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. Despite identifying eleven same-sector peers in Robotics & Manufacturing, none satisfied the narrow filtering criteria—same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier—needed to establish a statistically reliable comparable set. The available peer universe lacks sufficient clustering around Loombotic's specific characteristics to support median-based triangulation. The single public comparable and dispersed private peer set present data density constraints that preclude confident peer-relative analysis.

Without viable peer-median results, this analysis cannot produce a triangulated valuation range at present. Key uncertainties center on Loombotic's precise stage, prior fundraising history, and financial metrics relative to the identified private peers. To support future valuation work, data collection should focus on stage alignment within the peer set and access to financial multiples (revenue, growth rate, burn) from Exotec, Locus Robotics, and other leading comparables. Absent these inputs, peer triangulation remains underdetermined.
